senses.gloss: f. (= הָא with affixed ך locale) this, that.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 58a:10">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>הך איתתא</he> this woman here (myself).
<cite ref="Yoma 13a:9">Yoma 13ᵃ</cite> <he>מיתא הא קיימא הך</he> if this one should die, the other will be (his wife).
<cite ref="Yoma 13a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>והך לאו ביתו היא</he> but this one (appointed to become his wife eventually) is not ‘his house’ (not being his wife).—
<cite ref="Yevamot 23b:13">Yeb. 23ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>היינו הך</he> is not this the same case?; a. fr.
